title: Exercise library
subtitle: Turn trusted reference footage into clear, verified guidance for Mobile.
emptyBody: Try another pattern or search, or create an exercise to begin.
noHistory: Revisions appear here after an exercise is created or edited.
noVersions: No assessment versions yet. Inspect GOOD footage, then prepare a draft.
preserved: Saved assessments keep their original version and measurements.
capabilityHelp: A pattern groups movements. The processor capability determines which views, regions and measurements can be assessed. For example: Pull → Lat pulldown → Vertical pulldown.
noCapabilityHelp: You can manage this exercise in the library. Live reference preparation is unavailable until a compatible processor is verified.

fields.name: Exercise / variant name
fields.nameHelp: Use the name and instructions to distinguish exercise variants. Classification does not change the processor's capabilities.

createHelp: Create the exercise and its classification together. Add GOOD reference footage when you are ready.
editHelp: Changes create a new metadata revision. Published assessment snapshots stay unchanged.
created: Exercise created. Add GOOD footage to prepare an assessment.
retireHelp: Members will no longer discover its live configurations. Existing videos, reference versions and saved assessments remain accessible in history.
retiredNotice: This exercise is retired. Its history is preserved; restore it to prepare or publish new configurations.
retiredSaved: Exercise retired. History has been preserved.
uploadHelp: Use the exact exercise variant, a supported camera view and complete repetitions. Processing extracts pose, phases and reference measurements.
processing: Processing footage… Keep this workspace open. Large videos may take several minutes.
uploadSaved: Footage processed. Inspect the extracted evidence before preparing a configuration.
uploadFailedSaved: The upload was saved, but processing failed. Review the saved failure and add corrected footage.
fileTooLarge: Choose an MP4 video smaller than 500 MB.
noFootageBody: Add footage of this exact exercise. You will inspect the detected movement, body regions and repetitions before configuring Mobile.
viewHelp: Use the same view on Mobile. A front view cannot substitute for a verified side-view configuration.
failureHelp: Check the exact movement, full body visibility and complete repetitions. Correct the footage or processing setup, then add a new video. Failed footage cannot enable live assessment.
evidenceMissing: This video has no aligned review evidence yet. Generate it to inspect pose, repetitions and phases.
regenerateHelp: Re-extracts the visual overlay from this video. Published reference measurements and past assessments are preserved. To generate a new canonical profile, add corrected GOOD footage.
noReps: No segmented repetitions are available for this video.
regionHelp: Select a region to highlight its joints in the video. Counts show visible joints out of mapped joints at this moment. Required regions are defined by the supported capability.
featureHelp: Select a feature to highlight its joints and inspect its measured trajectory. Click the plot to seek the video.
noTarget: No proposed target for this measurement
sampled: Overlay evidence is sampled at up to 8 fps. Gaps mean evidence is unavailable, not a measured movement.
sourceMismatch: This video did not contribute to the selected reference version. Choose a contributing video before confirming the configuration.

featureDescriptions.kneeAngleDeg: Hip–knee–ankle angle; shows knee bending through the movement.
featureDescriptions.hipAngleDeg: Shoulder–hip–knee angle; shows hip bending through the movement.
featureDescriptions.torsoInclinationDeg: Angle of the shoulder-to-hip line relative to vertical.
featureDescriptions.upperArmElevationDeg: Hip–shoulder–elbow angle; shows upper-arm elevation relative to the torso.

referenceHelp: These measurements summarize accepted GOOD repetitions. Confirm the reference before publishing a Mobile configuration.
referencePublished: Reference measurements published. Review the Mobile configuration next.
noReference: No usable reference profile yet. Inspect the processing result and add corrected footage if needed.
draftHelp: Create an editable draft from the selected reference. Nothing changes for Members until you review and publish it.
draftCreated: Draft prepared. Inspect its measurements, select supported cues and record your review.
inspectBeforeReview: Open contributing footage and inspect its aligned evidence before saving a new review.
referencePublishHelp: This becomes the active reference for this camera view. A Mobile configuration tied to the previous reference may become unavailable until a matching configuration is published. Past assessments are preserved.
readOnly: This version is immutable. Prepare a new draft to make changes.
referenceOnly: Targets describe the approved GOOD example. They are not validated biomechanical fault thresholds.
measureHelp: The repetition driver is required. Other supported features may be included or removed. Body-region requirements and measured bounds cannot be edited by inventing values.
rulesHelp: Enable only cues supported by the footage. Cues compare measured values with this reference's observed target during the listed movement phases.
cueLanguage: The published wording is shown as stored; changing Admin language does not translate the Mobile configuration.
noRules: No supported feedback rule was proposed. Measurements alone do not imply a corrective conclusion.
reviewNoteHelp: Describe the footage, visibility and any feature or cue choices you verified. Required before publication.
reviewPlaceholder: What did you verify in the reference footage?
reviewSaved: Review saved. Preview what Mobile will use, then publish when ready.
saveFirst: Save your latest review changes before publishing.
dirtyLeaveHelp: Your published configuration is unchanged. Save the review to keep these choices, or discard them before leaving.
rejectHelp: The draft remains in version history. Members keep the current published version, if one exists.
rejectSaved: Draft rejected. Published versions are unchanged.
noCurrent: No live version yet. Publishing will make this the first available configuration for this view.
mobilePreviewHelp: A pinned configuration version runs on the phone. Published changes apply to new sessions; saved sessions keep their original configuration.
readinessGates: Required body regions, compatible camera view and stable starting pose
timing: Cues wait {{dwell}} ms and repeat no more often than every {{cooldown}} s.
publishHelp: This replaces the current live configuration for this exercise and camera view. Other views and saved assessments are preserved.
acknowledge: I checked the reference footage, selected measurements and enabled cues for this exact exercise and view.
published: Configuration published. Members can load this exact version.
notPublishedHelp: The exercise, reference measurements and configuration must all be active and compatible.
publishBlocked: Save the configuration review and publish its reference measurements first.
versionHelp: Open a version to inspect its original settings. Creating a draft never overwrites an existing version.

errors.preview: This video could not be played. Regenerate its visual evidence to rebuild a compatible preview; the original reference history is preserved.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Your saved data is preserved. Check the connection and try again.
errors.duplicate: An exercise with this name already exists. Use a distinct variant name or edit the existing exercise.
errors.classification: The exercise classification changed. Prepare a compatible reference and a new configuration.
errors.visual: Generate and inspect aligned visual evidence for the contributing footage before confirming this configuration.
errors.concurrent: Another change was saved. Refresh the workspace before retrying.
errors.reference: Publish the exact reference measurements before publishing the Mobile configuration.
errors.approval: Save the reviewed configuration before publication.
errors.forbidden: This action requires Platform Admin access.
errors.missing: This record is unavailable. Return to the library and refresh.
